scripture.verse: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake by Elijah.
For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given.
But the God of all grace who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.

sermons.title: Sermon 293 | The King's Highway Opened and Cleared

scripture.verse: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
But are there not with you, even with you, sins against the Lord your God?
The forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace.

Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.

sermons.title: Sermon 297-98 | Mr. Evil-Questioning Tried and Executed

scripture.verse: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean?
